title: Assignment 25 · Stipulated remedies
summary: Stipulated remedies. Assigned readings and principal cases for this class.
notes:
Figgie International, Inc. v. Destileria Serralles, Inc.: Uncontradicted evidence of industry practice supplied an exclusive repair, replacement, or refund remedy; the completed refund prevented that remedy from failing merely because earlier repair efforts had been unsuccessful.

Dave Gustafson & Co. v. State: A graduated daily charge for delay in completing a public highway was enforceable as a reasonable advance estimate of losses that were difficult to measure.

Lake River Corp. v. Carborundum Co.: A minimum-quantity damages formula was an unenforceable penalty because it required payment for unperformed services without crediting the service provider’s saved costs; ordinary breach damages remained available.

Wasserman’s Inc. v. Township of Middletown: A lease-cancellation payment based on gross receipts required factual examination of its reasonableness; the court preserved reimbursement for improvements but did not finally uphold or invalidate the receipts formula.

Swiss Federal Supreme Court: contractual penalty decision of September 24, 2024: The translated excerpt upholds reduction of a contractual penalty to CHF 10,000 for a minor breach with no demonstrated damage or risk, while preserving a punitive function for the clause.

Additional assigned materials: Swiss penalty-clause readings.
